summary: Produced test spec and test code for API-03 (GET /instances/:id and GET /instances). Created tests/specs/API-03.md with 21 test cases. Created tests/unit/api03_handler_test.zig with 9 deterministic unit tests for handler-level validation (UUID parsing, status enum, page_size bounds, cursor format, cursor expiry). Created tests/integration/api03_instance_read_test.zig with 12 integration tests against a real PostgreSQL store. Registered the integration test module in tests/integration/main_test.zig and wired the unit test target into build.zig. Fixed a pre-existing blocker in src/api/routes/instances.zig where two uses of std.time.nanoTimestamp() (not available in Zig 0.16) were replaced with a new private helper currentMicrosecondTimestamp() that uses std.os.windows.ntdll.RtlGetSystemTimePrecise() on Windows and posix.system.clock_gettime(.REALTIME) on POSIX. zig build and zig build test both exit 0.

issues_found.description: src/api/routes/instances.zig used std.time.nanoTimestamp() (lines 618 and 665) which does not exist in Zig 0.16.0. Fixed by adding currentMicrosecondTimestamp() helper using OS-native APIs (RtlGetSystemTimePrecise on Windows, clock_gettime on POSIX). This was a pre-existing bug introduced by BACKEND-DEV.
